# Alfa Triton Engineering

> Western Sydney engineering workshop, established 1974. Precision CNC machining, gear cutting (up to 2 m diameter), stainless steel and sheet metal fabrication, TIG/MIG welding, machine design and reverse engineering, plus a 24/7 on-site breakdown service for production lines.

- Trading name of Alfa Triton Products Pty Ltd. Australian owned and operated.
- Workshop: 18 Wentworth St, Clyde NSW 2142, Australia.
- Phone: 02 9642 2899 (workshop) · Email: sales@alfatriton.com
- Service area: Greater Sydney, Central Coast, Wollongong (Illawarra), Blue Mountains.
- Industries: food & beverage, pharmaceutical, printing & packaging, rail & transport, steel & heavy industry, engineering workshops.
- 12-month warranty on all products; work built and tested to Australian Standards.
